queries_run: TransMedics TMDX market share competitor 2026 OCS vs XVIVO Paragonix OrganOx
TransMedics new entrant warm perfusion competitor FDA approval 2026

findings.claim: 10-K稱OCS是市場上唯一獲FDA核准的可攜式多器官溫灌注裝置；冷保存／冷灌注供應分散。
findings.excerpt: Our Organ Care System is the only FDA approved portable, multi-organ, warm perfusion device on the market.

findings.claim: 10-K風險因子承認他方可能開發更好、更便宜產品使OCS過時，且許多對手資源更大。
findings.excerpt: Other companies may develop technologies and products that result in improved patient outcomes or are safer, easier to use, less expensive or more readily accepted than the OCS.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋摘要未取得可逐字引用的2026份額數據；各聚合站份額數字互相矛盾（約15-27%對1.55%），不採用。搜尋結果提及XVIVO Heart Assist Transport（冷灌注）2026年可能獲PMA、OrganOx被Terumo收購、Paragonix屬Getinge，均未讀原頁，列為線索。

clues.claim: XVIVO心臟冷灌注Heart Assist Transport預期2026年有機會獲FDA PMA核准，主要對手為TransMedics。
clues.source: briefglance: New Hope for Hearts: XVIVO Trial Boosts Organ Viability
